name: Traveling
overview: Scripture reveals that traveling involves seeking God's help and presence, as seen in Psalms 121:1 where the believer looks to the hills for divine aid. God is both near and far, assuring His omnipresence for those on journeys (Jeremiah 23:23). Jesus exemplified purposeful travel for prayer and ministry, withdrawing to solitary places to commune with the Father (Mark 1:35; Luke 5:16) and moving with a mission to preach and bring healing to the brokenhearted (Luke 4:18). The kingdom of heaven is likened to a king who accounts for his servants, reminding believers that their travels and labors are under God's sovereign oversight (Matthew 18:23).
